headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 16, 2026**
article:
Top MLB News

The Arizona Diamondbacks have placed left fielder Tommy Troy on the 10-day injured list retroactive to July 12, 2026, due to a sprained right AC joint. The Milwaukee Brewers made a significant move on July 15, 2026, acquiring outfielder Jadyn Fielder from the Houston Astros in exchange for right-handed pitcher Lance McCullers Jr., left-handed pitcher Colton Gordon, and cash.

Injuries and Availability Impact

Several teams have suffered injuries to key players. The Arizona Diamondbacks' Tommy Troy has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a sprained right AC joint. The Milwaukee Brewers' Rob Zastryzny has been placed on the 60-day injured list with a left trapezius strain. The Washington Nationals' Drew Millas has been placed on the 10-day injured list retroactive to July 12, 2026, with a left index finger fracture. The Kansas City Royals' Nick Mears has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list with a right shoulder impingement.

Trades and Roster Movement

The Milwaukee Brewers have acquired outfielder Jadyn Fielder from the Houston Astros in exchange for right-handed pitcher Lance McCullers Jr., left-handed pitcher Colton Gordon, and cash. The Brewers have also traded right-handed pitcher Easton McGee to the Kansas City Royals for cash. The Boston Red Sox have acquired outfielder Jahmai Jones from the Detroit Tigers in exchange for a player to be named later.
